occurrence_sentence: Niels Nielsen, co-founder of 2xN commented: "We are thrilled to lead the funding round and forge a partnership with QSimulate.

In a multi-year partnership with Google Quantum AI (see details in [a recent Google Research blog article](https://blog.research.google/2023/10/developing-industrial-use-cases-for.html)), QSimulate has played a key role in the development of fault-tolerant quantum computing algorithms for chemical, material, and biomolecular problems.
